record.name: Attio
record.one_liner: Attio is a CRM platform featuring a public REST API, App SDK, and MCP server for building integrations and agentic workflows.

auth.notes: Attio supports OAuth 2.0 for API authentication and developer connections.

access.notes: Developers can sign in to the developer console with an Attio account to create apps, and anyone can sign up for a free Attio account.

api_surface.notes: Attio provides a public REST API exchanging JSON over HTTPS, an App SDK for embedding TypeScript React applications, webhooks, and an MCP server.

mcp.notes: Attio provides an MCP server (Attio MCP) to connect AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to search, update, and manage workspaces.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve developer accounts allow anyone to sign in and build apps using documented REST API and OAuth 2.0 mechanisms.
